text:
[LTIM.10.3] A zone is resolved ([LTIM.10.7]) at two sites, and no others:

- `t.local(tz)` evaluation per [LTIM.3.2.1].
- `t.date(tz)` evaluation per [LTIM.3.3.1].

Writing a temporal value as text resolves no zone. The `::String` cast
([LCST.4.5.9]) and the `to_string` member ([LTIM.8.1.2]) write the value's own
offset ([LTIM.8.2.4]), and the `epoch_*` forms ([LTIM.8.2.1]) are UTC integers.
`calendar.time` resolves none either: it builds a UTC instant ([LTIM.14.1]).
